newsitem.title: UK: British trucker guilty of killing French student.
newsitem.headline: British trucker guilty of killing French student.

text.p: A British truck driver was found guilty on Wednesday and jailed for life for the murder last December of hitch-hiking French student Celine Figard.
Stuart Morgan, 37, murdered 19-year-old Figard in the cab of his truck shortly before last Christmas, after picking her up at a motorway service station in the west of England.
The accountancy student was on her way to visit her cousin when she disappeared, sparking a nationwide hunt which ended 10 days later when her naked body was found hidden in woodland.
She had been beaten, raped and strangled before being dumped by Morgan. Prosecutors said the long-distance lorry driver kept the body for 10 days in the bunk bed where he had raped her.
"What you did to Celine has caused revulsion in the minds of all right-thinking people," the judge told Morgan in Worcester Crown court.
Figard's parents had travelled from their home in Besancon in rural eastern France for the trial.
Figard's father Bernard, 46, said he was grateful for the verdict and hoped his life imprisonment "would not be shortened."
"Why and how in our society is a man capable of such cruelty and such atrocity? Where does he get his inspiration?" he asked reporters through an interpreter.
Morgan was arrested in February and charged after police found items of Figard's clothing in the home he shared with his common-law wife and eight-year-old son.
He denied murdering Figard but admitted to picking her up and said she consented to having sex with him.
Spots of blood matching Figard's were found in his truck cab and the bloodsoaked bunk from his lorry was found in his garage.
Morgan also gave away as Christmas presents two rare bottles of champagne Figard brought with her from France.
